title: status() validation logic needs clearer doc comment
description: The status() method validates that TailscaleIPs is non-empty, confirming the daemon is authenticated and has network identity. The current doc comment says it 'confirms tailscaled is connected to the control plane' which is subtly wrong — connectivity alone isn't the guarantee. A new contributor might not understand the product significance of this check. Suggest clarifying: 'Validates that at least one tailnet IP is present, confirming the daemon is logged in and has assigned identity on the tailnet.'
